arrivals.line: - **T31** In `src/everyNth4.js`: `everyNth4(text)` returns the characters at positions 0, 4, 8, … of the text, as a string.
- **T32** In `src/ngrams5.js`: `ngrams5(text)` returns every substring of exactly 5 characters, in order of position (`[]` if the text is shorter).
- **T33** In `src/fixedWidth10.js`: Ids should line up: `fixedWidth10(num)` writes a whole number ≥ 0 left-filled with 0s so it is at least 10 characters wide.
- **T34** In `src/clamp7.js`: `clamp7(x)` returns x limited to the range -7…7 (values below become -7, above become 7).
- **T35** In `src/chunks11.js`: `chunks11(arr)` splits an array into consecutive arrays of 11 elements; the last one may be shorter; an empty array gives `[]`.
- **T36** In `src/longWords10.js`: `longWords10(text)` counts the words with more than 10 letters, where a word is a maximal run of the letters a-z / A-Z.
- **T37** In `src/limit1.js`: Volume control: `limit1(v)` keeps a number between minus 1 and plus 1, cutting anything outside to the nearest end.
- **T38** In `src/echo5.js`: `echo5(text)` repeats every word 5 times (words separated by any whitespace) and joins all of them with single spaces.
- **T39** In `src/sampleChars4.js`: For previews we thin text out: `sampleChars4(s)` keeps the first character and then every 4th one after it, dropping the rest.
- **T40** In `src/rotateLeft2.js`: `rotateLeft2(arr)` returns a new array rotated left by 2 positions (by 2 modulo the length; an empty array stays empty).
- **T41** In `src/longWords2.js`: `longWords2(text)` counts the words with more than 2 letters, where a word is a maximal run of the letters a-z / A-Z.
- **T42** In `src/ngrams2.js`: `ngrams2(text)` returns every substring of exactly 2 characters, in order of position (`[]` if the text is shorter).

- **T43** In `src/rotateLetters2.js`: A toy cipher: `rotateLetters2(s)` should replace each a–z / A–Z letter by the one 2 positions later, starting again at a after z, without changing case or touching anything that is not a letter.
- **T44** In `src/multiplesOf2.js`: `multiplesOf2(n)` returns an array of the first n positive multiples of 2 (`[2, 4, …]`; `[]` for 0).
- **T45** In `src/longWords3.js`: `longWords3(text)` counts the words with more than 3 letters, where a word is a maximal run of the letters a-z / A-Z.
- **T46** In `src/groupsOf11.js`: Paging helper: `groupsOf11(list)` cuts a list into pieces of 11 in order (only the final piece can have fewer), and no pieces at all for an empty list.
- **T47** In `src/toBase3.js`: `toBase3(n)` writes a non-negative integer in base 3 (digits 0-9 then lower-case letters).
- **T48** In `src/pad6.js`: `pad6(n)` takes a non-negative integer and returns it as a string with leading zeros up to 6 digits (longer numbers unchanged).
- **T49** In `src/limit5.js`: Volume control: `limit5(v)` keeps a number between minus 5 and plus 5, cutting anything outside to the nearest end.
- **T50** In `src/toBase2.js`: `toBase2(n)` writes a non-negative integer in base 2 (digits 0-9 then lower-case letters).
- **T51** In `src/ngrams10.js`: `ngrams10(text)` returns every substring of exactly 10 characters, in order of position (`[]` if the text is shorter).
- **T52** In `src/chunks6.js`: `chunks6(arr)` splits an array into consecutive arrays of 6 elements; the last one may be shorter; an empty array gives `[]`.
- **T53** In `src/cycleBy2.js`: Turn order: `cycleBy2(list)` moves the first 2 elements to the end, one by one (so the shift wraps around for short lists), returning a new list.
- **T54** In `src/echo7.js`: `echo7(text)` repeats every word 7 times (words separated by any whitespace) and joins all of them with single spaces.
- **T55** In `src/ngrams3.js`: `ngrams3(text)` returns every substring of exactly 3 characters, in order of position (`[]` if the text is shorter).
- **T56** In `src/pad7.js`: `pad7(n)` takes a non-negative integer and returns it as a string with leading zeros up to 7 digits (longer numbers unchanged).
- **T57** In `src/pad8.js`: `pad8(n)` takes a non-negative integer and returns it as a string with leading zeros up to 8 digits (longer numbers unchanged).
- **T58** In `src/toBase8.js`: `toBase8(n)` writes a non-negative integer in base 8 (digits 0-9 then lower-case letters).
- **T59** In `src/timesTable2.js`: Times tables for kids: `timesTable2(count)` lists 2×1, 2×2, … up to 2×count as numbers in an array (empty when count is 0).
- **T60** In `src/roundTo8.js`: `roundTo8(x)` returns the multiple of 8 nearest to the number x; exactly half-way goes up (towards +∞).
